messages:
priya: quick heads-up — the onboarding quickstart is blocked. sample app calls an admin list API to enumerate private models but the Python SDK Client doesn't expose it. curl works, SDK raises AttributeError. anyone seen this?

sam: which route? /v1/admin/models/list? iirc those admin ops were behind a separate AdminClient we never shipped in py. can you paste the error?

priya: error: `AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'list_models_admin'`
I ran: `from redwood import Client; c = Client(token=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']); c.list_models_admin()` — curl with same token returns 200 and list.

elaine: ugh — bad UX for first-run. short term: doc the REST fallback + a tiny requests snippet in quickstart. long term: add AdminClient to py and align retry/auth behaviors across SDKs.

sam: also flagging a related parity bug: node sdk auto-retries certain idempotent POSTs on 5xx/429; python does not. we had a demo where frontend retried after a 502 and python surfaced the error, leading to duplicate token usage in the app flow.

priya: was node sending Idempotency-Key? we saw double billing on a demo account.

sam: node attaches Idempotency-Key if caller sets it; it also has an internal heuristic to retry safe POSTs. python currently only retries on network errors via requests. mismatch changes failure semantics for integrators.

elaine: plan: (1) add REST fallback snippet to quickstart docs, (2) open py-sdk PR to add AdminClient (list/get/update minimal surface) and make retry policy configurable with safe defaults (no silent duplicates for non-idempotent ops), (3) add auth-scope tests and CI e2e hitting admin list via REST to catch regressions.

priya: please paste the quick workaround so i can patch CI now.

sam: workaround (python requests): `import os, requests; r = requests.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/models/list', headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"}); print(r.json())`
Also for streaming generation use `stream=True` + `r.iter_lines()` to mimic REST streaming.

elaine: filing GH issue and will include a unit test asserting no silent retries for POSTs without explicit Idempotency-Key.

devex-bot: Created issue #543: "py-sdk: admin client + retry parity with node" and added label devex/priority-medium. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/543

priya: added to quickstart checklist. thanks :thumbsup:
